description: This Java source file defines the class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' which implements the 'LogNode' interface. It acts as a filter that passes only the message part of logs to the next node in a logging chain, useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A logger filter class that forwards only log messages to the next LogNode in the chain, ignoring other metadata.
